description: Defines the CordzInfo class for tracking and profiling Cord objects within the Abseil library, including methods for tracking, untracking, locking, and accessing Cord representations and statistics.

classes.name: CordzInfo
classes.description: Tracks profiling information for Cord objects, manages their lifecycle, and provides thread-safe access and updates to Cord representations and statistics.

methods.name: TrackCord
methods.description: Creates and starts tracking a Cord for profiling, storing its info in a global list.

methods.name: TrackCord (overload)
methods.description: Creates and tracks a Cord with parent info for copy or assignment operations.

methods.name: MaybeTrackCord
methods.description: Randomly profiles a Cord based on profiling criteria.

methods.name: MaybeTrackCord (overload)
methods.description: Profiles a Cord based on parent info and profiling criteria.

methods.name: Untrack
methods.description: Stops tracking a Cord and cleans up associated profiling info.

methods.name: MaybeUntrackCord
methods.description: Safely untracks a Cord if profiling info exists.

methods.name: Head
methods.description: Returns the oldest active CordzInfo in the current snapshot.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next older CordzInfo in the list.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the CordzInfo for thread-safe updates.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the CordzInfo, possibly deleting it if the Cord has been cleared.

methods.name: AssertHeld
methods.description: Asserts that the lock on the CordzInfo is held.

methods.name: SetCordRep
methods.description: Updates the Cord representation associated with this profiling info.

methods.name: RefCordRep
methods.description: Returns a reference to the current Cord representation, with thread safety.

methods.name: GetCordzStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves profiling statistics for the Cord.

methods.name: GetStack
methods.description: Returns the stack trace where the Cord was first sampled.

methods.name: GetParentStack
methods.description: Returns the parent stack trace for the sampled Cord.
